title: Bunny with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='22' rx='9' ry='20' fill='#e8a0b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='22' rx='5' ry='15' fill='#ffc4d8'/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='22' rx='9' ry='20' fill='#e8a0b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='22' rx='5' ry='15' fill='#ffc4d8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#f0c8d8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='24' fill='#f8dce8'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='56' r='6' fill='#ffb0c8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='56' r='6' fill='#ffb0c8'/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='47' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#5a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='44.5' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='49' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='47' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#5a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='44.5' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='49' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#ff8aa8'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 58 Q50 63 45 63' stroke='#d07090' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 58 Q50 63 55 63' stroke='#d07090' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='26' y1='54' x2='38' y2='56' stroke='#d8a0b8' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='26' y1='60' x2='38' y2='59' stroke='#d8a0b8' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='54' x2='62' y2='56' stroke='#d8a0b8' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='60' x2='62' y2='59' stroke='#d8a0b8' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkles near left eye -->
  <g fill='#fff2a8'>
    <polygon points='30,38 31.5,41 35,41.5 32,43.5 33,47 30,45 27,47 28,43.5 25,41.5 28.5,41'/>
    <polygon points='52,35 53,37 55,37.3 53.5,38.7 54,41 52,39.5 50,41 50.5,38.7 49,37.3 51,37'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles near right eye -->
  <g fill='#a8f0ff'>
    <polygon points='70,38 71.5,41 75,41.5 72,43.5 73,47 70,45 67,47 68,43.5 65,41.5 68.5,41'/>
  </g>
  <!-- little paws -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='92' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f8dce8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='92' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f8dce8'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='80' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
